body.intent: Fix The web roadmap page served under a project (/p/rhiza/roadmap) lists change sets and milestones from every registered project, not only that project's (owner, 2026-11-13: 'The roadmap tab doesn't filter between projects properly, it shows things from both projects'). loadRoadmap (internal/web/roadmap.go:105) reads /api/roadmap?all=true through the API handler in the request context; check whether that handler, or all=true, reaches across the root's projects instead of the scoped project. Wanted: each project's roadmap shows only its own change sets and milestones, with a test serving two projects' roadmaps and asserting no cross-project rows.
